entries.partTitle: The Rendering Equation & Monte Carlo Numerical Integration

spec.title: System Architecture: The Rendering Equation & Monte Carlo Numerical Integration

steps.caption: Architectural overview displays the continuous rendering equation formulated as a hemispherical radiance integral.
Deep inspection tracks numerical Monte Carlo estimation using low-discrepancy stratified sample sequences.
Comparative analysis contrasts unbiased random sampling against biased analytical lighting approximations.
Verification confirms mathematical estimator convergence and zero systematic energy bias.

steps.caption: Architectural overview illustrates cosine-weighted hemisphere importance sampling utilizing concentric disk mapping.
